Name: ScaleIsolate
Description: Isolates scale for selected controls by driving a sibling node via matrix and reparenting children.

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Prevents the scale of specified controls from affecting their children.

How To Use:
  Select the controls in the scene and click 'Add Selected' below. Then click build.

Fields:
- SetControlsList: List of controls to process.
- AutoParentChildren: If true, existing children of the controls will be reparented under the new _ScaleIsolated groups automatically.
